# 🎨 Customise charts and maps

All charts and maps follow a few settings, set once per R session with
[`fao_settings()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_settings.md).
Run it without arguments to see the current settings:

``` r

fao_settings()
#>   lang            en
#>   theme           bw
#>   base_size       12
#>   palette         npg
#>   map_palette     deep-orange
#>   map_center      0
#>   map_projection  longlat
#>   map_land        grey90
#>   map_ocean       NA
#>   grid            FALSE
#>   dpi             600
#>   pptx            FALSE
#>   data_dir        C:/Users/<you>/AppData/Local/R/data/R/faofishingreport
#>   font            SimSun
```

| Setting | Choices | Default |
|----|----|----|
| `lang` | `"en"`, `"zh"`, `"both"` | `"en"` |
| `theme` | `"bw"`, `"classic"`, `"minimal"`, `"light"`, `"linedraw"`, `"gray"`, `"dark"`, or a ggplot2 theme | `"bw"` |
| `base_size` | Base font size | `12` |
| `font` | Font family of chart text | chosen for the system |
| `palette` | Category colours: ggsci, RColorBrewer, `"Okabe-Ito"`, `"viridis"`, … or colours | `"npg"` |
| `map_palette` | Map colours: Material (`"deep-orange"`, …), RColorBrewer (`"YlOrRd"`, …), viridis, or colours | `"deep-orange"` |
| `map_center` | `0` (longitudes -180 to 180) or `180` (0 to 360) | `0` |
| `map_projection` | `"longlat"`, `"robinson"`, `"mollweide"`, `"equal_earth"`, `"winkel_tripel"`, `"mercator"`, a PROJ string or EPSG code | `"longlat"` |
| `map_land`, `map_ocean` | Colour of countries without data, of the ocean | `"grey90"`, none |
| `grid` | Background grid lines (graticules on maps) | `FALSE` |
| `dpi` | Resolution of the PNG files | `600` |
| `pptx` | Also save editable PowerPoint files (needs the eoffice package) | `FALSE` |
| `data_dir` | Folder of downloaded FAO data | R user data folder |

`fao_settings(reset = TRUE)` restores the defaults. A wrong name or
value gives an error at once, with the choices available.

## 🌐 Language

Every analysis has a `lang` argument; `fao_settings(lang = ...)` changes
the default for all of them. `"both"` writes Chinese and English
together, e.g. “百万吨 (Million Tonnes)” and “摩洛哥 Morocco”.

``` r

fao_settings(lang = "zh")
fishing_area_country(FAO34$area_data, rank_range = c(1, 6))
```

![area_country.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/area/area_country.png`

``` r

fao_settings(lang = "both")
fishing_area_country(FAO34$area_data, rank_range = c(1, 6))
fao_settings(lang = "en")
```

![area_country.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/area/area_country.png`

The older argument `ZH = TRUE` still works and means `lang = "zh"`.

## 🖼️ Themes

``` r

fao_settings(theme = "classic")
fishing_area_country(FAO34$area_data, rank_range = c(1, 6))
```

![area_country.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/area/area_country.png`

``` r

fao_settings(theme = "minimal", base_size = 14)
fishing_area_country(FAO34$area_data, rank_range = c(1, 6))
```

![area_country.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/area/area_country.png`

Any ggplot2 theme can be used,
e.g. `fao_settings(theme = ggplot2::theme_light(base_size = 13))`.

## 🎨 Colour palettes

`palette` colours countries, species and groups:

``` r

fao_settings(theme = "bw", base_size = 12, palette = "lancet")
fishing_area_country(FAO34$area_data, rank_range = c(1, 6))
```

![area_country.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/area/area_country.png`

``` r

fao_settings(palette = "Okabe-Ito")        # suitable for colour-blind readers
fishing_area_country(FAO34$area_data, rank_range = c(1, 6))
```

![area_country.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/area/area_country.png`

``` r

fao_settings(palette = c("#0B2E5B", "#16A6B6", "#F28E2B", "#E15759", "#59A14F", "#B07AA1"))
fishing_area_country(FAO34$area_data, rank_range = c(1, 6))
fao_settings(palette = "npg")
```

![area_country.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/area/area_country.png`

Palettes of the ggsci package include `"npg"`, `"aaas"`, `"nejm"`,
`"lancet"`, `"jama"`, `"jco"`, `"d3"`; of RColorBrewer `"Set1"`,
`"Set2"`, `"Dark2"`, `"Paired"`; of base R
[`grDevices::palette.pals()`](https://rdrr.io/r/grDevices/palette.html)
and
[`grDevices::hcl.pals()`](https://rdrr.io/r/grDevices/palettes.html).
More categories than a palette has are interpolated.

## 🗺️ Map projections

The same map, the catch of each country in area 34, in each projection:

``` r

fao_settings(map_projection = "longlat")      # plain longitude-latitude (default)
fishing_area_data("Atlantic, Eastern Central")
```

![area_country_map.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/area_country_map.png`

``` r

fao_settings(map_projection = "robinson")
fishing_area_data("Atlantic, Eastern Central")
```

![area_country_map.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/area_country_map.png`

``` r

fao_settings(map_projection = "equal_earth")
fishing_area_data("Atlantic, Eastern Central")
```

![area_country_map.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/area_country_map.png`

``` r

fao_settings(map_projection = "mollweide")
fishing_area_data("Atlantic, Eastern Central")
```

![area_country_map.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/area_country_map.png`

``` r

fao_settings(map_projection = "winkel_tripel")
fishing_area_data("Atlantic, Eastern Central")
```

![area_country_map.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/area_country_map.png`

``` r

fao_settings(map_projection = "mercator")
fishing_area_data("Atlantic, Eastern Central")
```

![area_country_map.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/area_country_map.png`

Any other projection can be given as a PROJ string or EPSG code, e.g.
`fao_settings(map_projection = "+proj=natearth")` or `"EPSG:3857"`.

## 🌏 Pacific-centred maps

`map_center = 180` shows longitudes 0 to 360, with the Pacific in the
centre. Areas and countries that the data split at the dateline
(e.g. the Pacific areas, Russia) are joined again:

``` r

fao_settings(map_projection = "robinson", map_center = 180)
fishing_area_data("Pacific, Northwest")
```

![area_country_map.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/area_country_map.png`

Fishing area maps show the land without country borders, and the
analysed country in red:

``` r

country_analysis("Morocco")
```

![Moroccofishing_area_map.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/country/Moroccofishing_area_map.png`

## 🖌️ Map colours

``` r

fao_settings(map_projection = "robinson", map_center = 0, map_palette = "viridis")
fishing_area_data("Atlantic, Eastern Central")
```

![area_country_map.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/area_country_map.png`

``` r

fao_settings(map_palette = "YlOrRd", map_land = "grey85", map_ocean = "#EAF4FB")
fishing_area_data("Atlantic, Eastern Central")
```

![area_country_map.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/area_country_map.png`

The `fill_scale` argument of
[`fishing_area_data()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fishing_area_data.md),
[`species_country()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/species_country.md)
and
[`country_analysis()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/country_analysis.md)
overrides `map_palette` for one call.

## 🔤 Fonts

The font is chosen for the operating system so that Chinese text
displays: SimSun on Windows, Songti SC on macOS, Noto Serif CJK SC on
Linux, or the next installed Chinese font. Change it with:

``` r

fao_font()                            # the current font
fao_settings(font = "Microsoft YaHei")
```

PNG files are drawn with the ragg package, which finds any installed
font by name; PowerPoint files use the same font name.

## 📐 Grid lines, resolution and PowerPoint

``` r

fao_settings(grid = TRUE)
fishing_area_country(FAO34$area_data, rank_range = c(1, 6))
fao_settings(grid = FALSE)
```

![area_country.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/area/area_country.png`

PowerPoint files are written with the eoffice package, which is not
installed with faofishingreport: run `install.packages("eoffice")` once
(on macOS, eoffice also needs [XQuartz](https://www.xquartz.org)).

``` r

fao_settings(dpi = 300)      # smaller PNG files
fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)    # also editable PowerPoint in figures/pptx/
fishing_area_species(FAO34$area_data, pptx = TRUE)   # or for one call only
```

## ⚙️ Arguments of each function

Besides the settings, the older analysis functions have their own style
arguments (line widths, point sizes, text sizes and colours); see their
help pages,
e.g. [`?fishing_area_data`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fishing_area_data.md),
and [🌊 Fishing area
analysis](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/articles/fishing-areas.md).

## 📝 Translations

Chinese names of countries, species and areas come from FAO. The Chinese
names of ISSCAAP groups, major groups and income groups
(`inst/extdata/group_names_zh.csv`) and all chart labels
(`inst/extdata/chart_labels.csv`) are plain CSV files: edit them in the
package source and reinstall the package to change the wording.
